method: Exact mapped node span text comparison; historical census; CP287 canonical row/node/scope crosswalk; two CP292 anchored metadata stores; exact equality with CP299 remaining owner row IDs. Local source contracts, not full current AST replay.

groups.title: Module imports and ownership
groups.meaning: Module docstring assigns orchestration, normalization and serialization, not trading validity; future annotations postpone evaluation; imports establish dependencies, comments no executable semantics.

groups.title: Bootstrap and shared imports
groups.meaning: Resolve own path then parents[1], sibling pipeline path, convert to string; insert at sys.path index zero only if exact string absent, do not move existing path. Flat shared imports follow bootstrap. Dynamic import failures propagate.

groups.title: Metadata and context
groups.meaning: Date format constant; public version 1.15.0, implementation 1.21.3 and modified timestamp current; extension 400; Tehran ZoneInfo and ContextVar default None. Historical version and modified literals changed only; new store nodes at 46 and 47 are current complement.

groups.title: Progress sink scope
groups.meaning: Context manager sets sink, retains token; yield without value; finally resets token including exceptional exit. Failure before try not protected. Nested scopes restore prior context, not global mutation.

groups.title: Progress envelope
groups.meaning: Create event status/label then expand details (mapping overwrite semantics); if duration non-null set durationMs rounded to two decimals, overriding any supplied detail. No price arithmetic.

groups.title: Progress delivery
groups.meaning: Get current ContextVar; only None chooses compact JSON with QG_PROGRESS prefix, stderr, flush=True; otherwise invoke sink with event. No local suppression of sink/encoding/print failures.

groups.title: Timing start and work
groups.meaning: Counter before started event, then work invoked inside try and result returned unchanged; start notification failure occurs before try and prevents work.

groups.title: Timing finalization
groups.meaning: Finally measure elapsed seconds times 1000, accumulate existing label default 0.0, emit completed even if work raised; cleanup failure can replace original exception/result. Only emitted duration rounded by emit_progress, ledger keeps elapsed numeric value.

groups.title: Module spec gate
groups.meaning: Resolve spec from supplied name/path; short-circuit spec None or loader None raises RuntimeError with path and reaction-engine wording even for other module names.

groups.title: Dynamic execution
groups.meaning: Create module from spec, assign sys.modules by spec.name before executing loader, then return module. No rollback of registered module if execution fails; existing name overwritten.

groups.title: Reaction loader
groups.meaning: Delegate load_module using fixed reaction_engine name and given path; no separate validation.

groups.title: Index selection
groups.meaning: Either bound None selects without converting index; otherwise inclusive start <= int(index) <= end; chained comparison short-circuits, no price rounding; conversion failure propagates when both bounds supplied.

groups.title: Reset selection
groups.meaning: Collect original reset objects in input order by Reset index; bounds delegated; no sorting, cloning or deduplication.

groups.title: Reaction selection
groups.meaning: Iterate input reactions, filter original First index before transform; only non-null callback invoked for accepted item; retain tuple original and public item, same reference if no transform. Return reactions and resets in encounter order.

groups.title: Selection override
groups.meaning: Non-null selected_items used directly, including empty collections; otherwise select once from result, bounds and callback. Unpack exactly two items; no re-selection on override.

groups.title: Legacy Reset serialization
groups.meaning: Produce ordered reset dictionaries with index, display epoch time, optional second time non-null guard, broken level string, fromFirstIndex. Preserve source identity values; no sort or precision quantization.

groups.title: Legacy Reaction serialization
groups.meaning: Iterate selected pairs in original order; ignore native member for public field values. Emit First, BoxTop and BoxBottom source indexes/display epochs and prices as strings, Break index/display epoch, mode. Break time unguarded, so incomplete public candidate can fail; no native mutation, no dedup. Return reactions then resets.

groups.title: Blue metadata
groups.meaning: List comprehension retains selected input order, direction/kind/reaction number/strike counts; Fibonacci level string only when non-null, otherwise null. No strike recomputation.

groups.title: Blue range and geometry
groups.meaning: Filter by getattr source_index without default; even unbounded filter evaluates attribute access first. Epoch for source/start/end, strings for source extreme and line price, optional broken level string; no validation flag or internal flag in legacy output. No clipping of line times.

groups.title: A provenance times
groups.meaning: No local filter; map caller-provided items in order. Direction and both Blue ordinals, both source/stop times converted via epoch; no optional guards.

groups.title: A continuation and trigger
groups.meaning: Stringify both Blue stop levels and continuation level, preserve continuation source and trigger indexes, convert times and exact event time separately; reaction number and first/break epochs retained.

groups.title: A source and validity
groups.meaning: Source index/time and price string; calculationValid literal true, not recomputed; optional native provenance route/event fields omitted from legacy schema. No sort, native mutation or new lifecycle validation.
